app.title: InkPass Studio
app.subtitle: A Splatoon ID generator for Inkblot Art Academy student IDs, Grizzco staff badges, and more.

home.uploadedSectionNote: Saved locally in this browser only — not published publicly and won't appear on other browsers or devices.
home.deleteConfirmDescription: Remove "{name}" from this browser? This cannot be undone unless you have an exported .zip copy.

editor.title: Card Editor
editor.notFoundDescription: No document template matches "{id}". Pick one from the gallery instead.
editor.fontLoadError: Could not load that font file. Please try a valid .ttf, .otf, or .woff2 font.

cropper.title: Crop ID Photo
cropper.description: Drag and zoom your photo to fit the card's portrait frame.

export.title: Export
export.bleedHint: Trim between 0 mm (finished size) and {max} mm (full template bleed).
export.multiSidePngHint: Exports the currently selected side ({side}) as high-res PNG. PDF includes all sides.

designer.title: Template Designer
designer.subtitle: Upload your artwork and fonts, position and style fields visually, then save to your browser or export as a shareable template (.zip).
designer.overwriteDraftDescription: You have an unsaved draft ("{name}"). Loading another template will replace it unless you save it to your browser first.
designer.resizeFieldsDescription: The uploaded image is {newW} × {newH} px, while the current canvas is {oldW} × {oldH} px. How would you like to handle existing fields?
designer.canvasHint: Click a box to select • Drag to move • Drag bottom-right handle to resize • Arrow keys nudge 1px (Shift = 10px)
designer.noFieldSelected: Click a field on the canvas or in the list to edit its coordinates and styling.
designer.thumbnailHint: Shown on the Templates gallery. Leave empty to use the first side's background.
designer.imageFileNotFound: Image file not found. Upload an image above or check the file name.
designer.siteFontsHint: Upload your own font above, or pick one of the built-in site fonts.
designer.repoAssetHint: Local uploads are preview-only. Enter a path relative to the template folder (e.g. ./front.png) so the exported config.json stays clean.
designer.docsSectionHint: Saved with your template and bundled as CREDITS.txt and LICENSE.txt in exported .zip files. Displayed to users via a Credits & License link in the Card Editor.
designer.creditsPlaceholder: Author, artist, fonts used, links, and notes...
designer.licensePlaceholder: Paste your license terms or apply a preset above...
designer.otherTabWarningTitle: Designer is open in another tab
designer.otherTabWarningBody: Auto-save is paused in this tab so your draft isn't overwritten. Switch to this tab to resume auto-saving here.

shortcutsModal.title: Designer Shortcuts & Canvas Tips
shortcutsModal.description: Use familiar InDesign / Photoshop / Figma shortcuts while arranging fields on the canvas.
shortcutsModal.inputNote: Keyboard shortcuts are automatically paused while typing inside form inputs so text editing isn't interrupted.
shortcutsModal.altDrag: Duplicate field while dragging (combinable with Shift)
shortcutsModal.altResize: Resize symmetrically from center (combinable with Shift)
shortcutsModal.disableSnap: Temporarily disable smart alignment snap guides
shortcutsModal.sendBackward: Send field backward in layer order
shortcutsModal.bringForward: Bring field forward in layer order
shortcutsModal.adjustFontSize: Decrease / increase text field font size (±1px)

designerForm.salmonRunPreset: Salmon Run Ranks (サーモンラン称号)
designerForm.templateBleed: Template Bleed (mm on each side — 0 for no bleed)
designerForm.templateIdHint: Used as the folder and .zip filename when exporting (e.g. my-card-id).
